newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up slightly against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up slightly against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up slightly at 8.3056 against the U.S. dollar in dull trading on Friday, from Thursday's 8.3059, on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market, traders said.
The yuan opened unchanged at an intra-day low of 8.3059 and consolidated between 8.3055 and 8.3057 for most of the session, hitting a intra-day high of 8.3049.
Trading was dull, with most done about 8.3057, traders said. Dealers said that the yuan rose to the 8.3050 level on increasing pro-yuan sentiment.
"The yuan hit an intra-day high above 8.3050, which stimulated buying to push it higher," said one dealer. "But it was capped at the level of 8.3050 by the central bank."
Dealers expect the yuan to consolidate around 8.3050 in the next few days.
The yuan closed up at 7.5945 from 7.6151 against 100 Japanese yen and down at 1.0746 from 1.0736 against the Hong Kong dollar.
